description:

About us: 



PTOE Global Solutions helps businesses operate with greater clarity, stability, accountability, and scalability. We provide managed business solutions that allow business owners and leadership teams to step back from day-to-day complexity and make better decisions through systems, processes, people, and technology. 



As PGS continues to manage client operations, internal ventures, and technology-enabled services, we are looking for a Data & Insights Analyst who can turn business, operational, customer, and application data into useful insights that support better decisions. 



Role Summary: 



The Data & Insights Analyst will be responsible for collecting, analyzing, interpreting, and presenting data from client systems, internal platforms, databases, applications, and operational processes. 



  



This role is not only about producing reports. The ideal candidate must be able to identify patterns, trends, risks, gaps, and opportunities in the data, then translate them into clear insights and practical recommendations for business leaders, delivery teams, clients, and product teams. 



The role will support PGS clients, internal business units, SaaS/community applications, and leadership reporting. 



 



 



Key Responsibilities: 



 

Data Analysis & Reporting: 



Analyze data from databases, business applications, client systems, spreadsheets, and operational workflows. 



Build recurring reports, dashboards, and performance summaries. 



Identify trends, patterns, outliers, risks, and opportunities in business and customer data. 



Translate raw data into clear insights that can support decision-making. 



Prepare weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reports for leadership, clients, and internal teams. 



Monitor key performance indicators across client accounts, business operations, and digital platforms. 



 



Business Insights: 



Provide recommendations based on data findings, not just descriptive reporting. 



Help leadership understand what is happening, why it is happening, and what action should be considered. 



Identify process bottlenecks, customer behaviour patterns, usage trends, productivity issues, and operational risks. 



Support client reviews by preparing meaningful insights and business summaries. 



Work with delivery, technology, marketing, and operations teams to improve performance using data. 



 

Database & Application Data: 



Query and extract data from relational databases and application backends. 



Work with developers and technical teams to understand data structures, fields, and business logic. 



Validate data quality, consistency, and completeness. 



Help define reporting requirements for new applications, client systems, and internal platforms. 



Support data tracking needs for community apps, SaaS platforms, and client-facing solutions. 



 



Dashboards & Visualization: 



Create clear dashboards and visual reports for business users. 



Present data in a simple, practical, and executive-friendly way. 



Use charts, tables, summaries, and narrative insights to explain findings. 



Design dashboards that help teams quickly understand performance, trends, and priorities. 



 

Data Governance & Quality: 



Help establish basic data standards, definitions, and reporting consistency. 



Identify data quality issues and work with teams to resolve them. 



Document reporting logic, metrics definitions, data sources, and assumptions. 



Support privacy, confidentiality, and secure handling of client and business data. 



 

Required Skills & Experience: 



5+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, analytics, or a similar role. 



Strong ability to analyze data and explain findings in simple business language. 



Experience working with databases, spreadsheets, dashboards, and reporting tools. 



Strong SQL skills for querying and analyzing data. 



Experience with tools such as Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau, Metabase, or similar platforms. 



Ability to clean, structure, and validate data from multiple sources. 



Strong attention to detail and accuracy. 



Ability to identify patterns, trends, exceptions, and business implications. 



Experience working with operational, customer, product, marketing, or financial data. 



Strong communication skills and ability to present insights to non-technical stakeholders. 



 



Preferred Skills: 



Experience with SaaS, community platforms, client portals, or web/mobile applications. 



Familiarity with MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar environments. 



Experience supporting business owners, operations teams, or managed service environments. 



Understanding of customer behaviour analytics, cohort analysis, retention, engagement, and usage metrics. 



Experience with API data, CRM data, marketing analytics, or support ticket data. 



Basic knowledge of Python, R, or data automation tools is an asset. 



Experience creating executive dashboards and client-facing reports. 



Understanding of AI-assisted reporting or data interpretation tools is an asset. 





Core Soft Skills:  



Strong communication, collaborative leadership style, and an ability to thrive in agile environments. 



 



What we offer: 



Competitive renumeration.  



Flexible work hours & remote options.  



Opportunity to work on multiple exciting projects in a dynamic environment.  



Collaborative and innovative team culture.

title: Amazon FBA Product Research & Sourcing Virtual Assistant (Bundle Specialist)
description:
Job Description

We're looking for a detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to join our Amazon FBA business as a Product Research & Sourcing Specialist, focused specifically on finding profitable bundle product opportunities.

You'll be trained on our proven 5-method research framework (Helium 10 Blackbox, Store Scouting, Vine Reviewer method, Keyword Search, and Bestseller drilling) and our "Good Market vs Bad Market" validation checklist. Your job is to find products that pass every check, pair them into smart bundles, and get them sourcing-ready.

This is an ongoing, long-term role — we want someone who gets better at this every week and eventually owns the research pipeline with minimal oversight.



Responsibilities



Use Helium 10 Blackbox to mine product databases using our filter criteria (review count, sales volume, price range, seller count)

Run the "Quick X-Ray Snapshot" check on every candidate (market size $150k+/month, average reviews under 300–500, price within $15–$30 range)

Apply our full Good Market vs Bad Market checklist (no Amazon Basics, no single-brand dominance, 30%+ margins, non-electrical, stable demand)

Find complementary bundle pairing products for each validated main product — products that solve the same problem, are bought together, and increase AOV

Verify every ASIN directly on Amazon (live listing check — no guessing or cached data)

Find 1–2 competitor ASINs per product for benchmarking

Fill out our standardised Excel tracking sheet (template provided) with: product name, ASIN, sell price, COGS estimate, Amazon fees, profit, ROI, margin %, and competitor ASIN

Begin early-stage sourcing research on Alibaba for shortlisted products — request quotes, MOQs, and sample costs from 2–3 suppliers per product

Maintain a running shortlist spreadsheet with research method used, snapshot status, and notes





Requirements



Experience with Amazon FBA product research (Helium 10 experience is a big plus — we can also train)

Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills — comfortable with formulas, formatting, and structured templates

Experience with Alibaba sourcing — requesting quotes, comparing suppliers, basic negotiation

Excellent attention to detail — ASIN accuracy and data verification are critical

Good written English for supplier communication

Self-motivated,  able to work through a structured process independently after initial training

Available for occasional video calls for training and weekly check-ins





Nice to Have



Previous experience working with an Amazon seller or FBA business

Familiarity with Amazon's bundling policies (Virtual Bundles vs Physical Bundles)

Experience with Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar tools

title: Operations VA
description:
About Free Money Meister

Free Money Meister is an AI-powered scholarship matching and prioritization platform. We help students find the right scholarships, rank them by their actual likelihood of winning, and execute on them. To date our students have won over $500,000 in scholarships, averaging roughly $12,500 per student.



We are a fast-moving, high-bar team. We are building something that matters, and we move quickly. The person in this role works alongside a small group of people who consistently go above and beyond, and we are looking for someone who operates the same way.



The Role

This is an outward-facing operations role. You will support outreach, research, course coordination, and marketing operations as we grow our beta and build our pipeline of partners and customers. You will report into our operations function and work closely with our Executive Assistant.



This is a part-time, hourly, remote position. We expect roughly 10 hours per week to start, with potential to grow as you prove yourself and as the company scales. Provide your proposed hourly rate. 



What You Will Actually Do

• Research and qualify prospective B2B2C partners (college consultants, financial planners, test-prep companies, education coaches) who serve families with college-bound students.

• Build and maintain prospect lists with the right data captured: contact details, fit rationale, and prioritization.

• Support outbound outreach campaigns and track responses and follow-ups.

• Coordinate course and content logistics tied to our learning platform.

• Provide general marketing support: scheduling, organizing assets, light campaign execution.

• Capture what is needed for registrations, sign-ups, and partner onboarding accurately and completely.



Who We Are Looking For

Experience is helpful but not required. We care far more about how you work than where you have worked. The right person is:

• Super responsive. You reply quickly and you communicate proactively. If you are blocked or unsure, we hear from you while you are working, not after.

• An overachiever. You go above and beyond. You notice things we did not ask about and surface them. You treat our goals as your goals.

• A strong independent thinker. You can take an ambiguous task, make a judgment call, and defend your reasoning. You do not just execute, you think.

• Efficient and honest about time. You use modern tools, including AI, to move fast. Your logged time reflects the actual scope of the work.

• A culture fit. You thrive on a small team that holds a high bar and moves fast. You take direction well and self-correct quickly.



Tools and AI

We expect you to use AI tools to work efficiently, and we view that as a strength, not something to hide. What we are evaluating is the judgment you add on top of the tools: the thinking, the prioritization, and the decisions. AI can build a list. It cannot d
 who matters most or why. That part is you.



A Note Before You Apply

You do not have to be an expert in this field. What we are looking for is someone who is smart, has grit and initiative, and goes above and beyond. If that is you, there is a quick accompanying gig included with this posting that we would like you to complete and send over together with your job application. It helps us assess you better.

Applications that include the completed gig will get our attention. The gig is your chance to show us who you are.



Gig

Below are four types of professionals we could partner with for our B2B2C customer segment. We offer “seats” to these professionals at a discounted price, this allows the students working with those professionals to access our platform at a discounted rate. Read all four categories, do research, and select the top 10-20 professionals in the state of Maryland, USA that we should start with based on highest probability/likelihood of conversion. Describe your process and why you made the choices that you made, the formatting is totally up to you. Note: If you want to make an impact, be part of fast growth, and work with a team that’s all willing to put in the work, then this is the right place for you. 



Who they are

1)Test-prep companies & tutoring centers - Businesses offering SAT/ACT prep, academic tutoring, and study support to students and families.

2) Independent college consultants - Private advisors who guide families through college admissions and applications.

3) Financial planners & wealth advisors - Professionals who help families plan finances, including saving and paying for college.

4) Parent & education coaches - Coaches who help parents and students navigate the college-readiness journey.



How We Hire

Resumes tell us very little about how someone actually works. So our process centers on the accompanying gig, which mirrors the real work of this role and lets us see how you think and make decisions. There is a brief real-time follow-up after you submit.



We are looking for the person who treats that gig the way they would treat the job: responsive, thoughtful, efficient, and a step beyond what was asked.

Logistics

• Type: Part-time, hourly, remote (contractor).

• Hours: Approximately 10 hours per week to start, with room to grow.

• Confidentiality: A signed NDA is required before access to any internal systems or materials.

title: AI Engineer / Autonomous Systems Builder — Claude Code + Open Models
description:
We're a US-based AI company running multiple brands — AI video production, AI-powered real estate technology, and a network of medical compliance clinics. We're hiring an AI Engineer who builds with autonomous agents the way developers used to build with frameworks.



The honest pitch: work that used to cost us $100,000/year in dev contracts now ships in a week with the right person and the right stack. We're looking for that person. Not someone who "uses AI for coding" — someone who's internalized that the harness around the model is the actual product, and who treats Claude Code, Kimi K2, GLM, Minimax, and Qwen as a routed orchestra, not competing chatbots.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BUILD



- Multi-agent workflows that run unsupervised overnight (planner / generator / evaluator architectures, not single-shot prompts)



- Real estate data pipelines pulling MLS, HUD records, and public sources into Supabase with webhook triggers



- Internal tools and dashboards for non-technical operators across our brands (we have a backlog)



- Custom MCP servers when none exist for what we need



- WordPress / Next.js sites cranked out fast with AI-native workflows (3-4 in the pipeline right now, and we pay well to ship them)



- Voice and video automation pipelines (Whisper, Seedance, fal.ai — bonus if you've touched these)



- Whatever the brief is next week, because the work is varied and we move fast



WHAT WE PROVIDE



- Paid access to every coding model and tool that matters — Claude Max, Kimi, GLM, Minimax, Codex, GPT, Gemini, whatever you need



- Infrastructure budget (Supabase, Vercel, Cloudflare, Runpod, VPS)



- Direct line to ownership — no project manager between you and the brief



- Long-term recurring work across multiple brands, not one-off projects



- Top performer becomes the lead and brings on junior builders under them



WHAT WE DON'T WANT



- "I use ChatGPT for code" people



- Anyone whose AI workflow stops at copy-paste



- WordPress-only developers with no scripting depth



- AI-polished applications that say "I am thrilled to apply for this exciting opportunity"



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY



The first wave of this evaluation is a video. Record a screen-share walkthrough (Loom, or an unlisted YouTube link), 5–10 minutes, of you talking through your actual setup. We're not looking for production value — we're looking for a builder who can show us their real stack, live, in their own voice. If it sounds like you're reading an AI script off a teleprompter, that's as obvious to us as an AI-written cover letter, and we'll pass.



In the video, walk us through:



1. Who you are, your time zone, and your daily driver — Claude Code? OpenCode? Cline? Something you rolled yourself? Show us the actual environment.



2. How you route your models — what's your orchestrator brain, what's your primary coder, what's your fallback, and how you d
. If you have a router or config, put it on screen and explain it.



3. What kind of agents you run — subagents, skills, slash commands, hooks, MCP servers. Show us the harness, not a description of it.



4. A run-through of one or two real things you've shipped. Bias toward the work we actually care about: overnight multi-agent workflows, real estate or public-data pipelines into Supabase, custom MCP servers, or voice/video automation (Whisper, Seedance, fal.ai). Screen-share the repo or the live product — show the commit history.



5. The honest part: a production failure. What broke, what you did, what you learned.



Then, in your written application, give us:



- Three portfolio links minimum — GitHub repos with visible commit history, live sites, or Looms of tools you've shipped. We look at the commit graphs.



- One line each: monthly rate expectation (within $800–$2,500), hours per week you can commit, your time zone, and your daily overlap with US Eastern.



We watch every video that comes with honest answers. We delete generic applications with no video.



BONUS (NOT REQUIRED, BUT NOTICED)



- Self-hosted observability (Langfuse, Helicone, claude-code-hooks-multi-agent-observability)



- Understanding of the "lethal trifecta" and prompt-injection mitigation



- FFmpeg / video pipeline work



- Real estate, mortgage, or regulated-industry experience



- Public writeups, blog posts, or X threads on agents



- GitHub commits in the last 30 days



DETAILS



- Job Type: Full-Time



- Salary: $800–$2,500/month, based on experience demonstrated in your video and application



- Hours: Flexible, with 3–4 hours of US Eastern overlap required daily

mbers is becoming filled with high priority work, which is where you come in!

We’re looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist who can identify conversion bottlenecks, implement high-impact fixes, and continuously improve the customer journey across our eCommerce client portfolio. This role exists to bridge the gap between paid acquisition and on-site conversion performance, ensuring traffic generated by our Paid Media Strategists converts at the highest possible rate. You’ll own the diagnosis, testing, implementation, and reporting of funnel improvements while helping scale winning conversion strategies across multiple brands. 



Requirements/Experience:



- 2+ years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), DTC eCommerce, funnel optimization, or Shopify growth operations

- Experience using tools such as GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar analytics platforms



- Hands-on experience building and updating landing pages and pre-sale pages using Replo or similar no-code builders



- Familiarity with quiz funnel platforms such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, or related tools



- Experience implementing and analyzing A/B tests using tools like Convert, GLO, Intelligems, or equivalent testing platforms



- Strong understanding of key eCommerce conversion metrics including LP CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, and funnel conversion flow



- Ability to write high-converting CRO-focused copy including headlines, CTAs, benefit-driven bullets, and trust-building messaging



- Strong analytical thinking with the ability to prioritize opportunities based on impact and effort



- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client funnels simultaneously



- Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with Paid Media Strategists and internal stakeholders



- High attention to detail and strong bias toward execution and accountability



- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven remote environment



Roles & Responsibilities for this position:



- Conduct monthly audits of each client’s full acquisition funnel, including the transition from ad creative to landing page/PDP, add-to-cart flow, checkout experience, and post-purchase confirmation journey



- Analyze funnel performance data using GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and related tools to identify drop-off points, friction areas, and conversion opportunities



- Develop and maintain a prioritized “funnel fix queue” for each client based on projected revenue lift, implementation effort, and business impact



- Collaborate closely with Paid Media Strategists to identify and communicate systemic funnel issues, including disconnects between ad messaging and landing page experience



- Build, launch, and optimize pre-sale pages in Replo to support paid acquisition campaigns and improve conversion performance

Implement updates to product detail pages (PDPs) using Shopify-native apps and templated modules without requiring custom Liquid development

- Write and refine conversion-focused copy for headlines, subheads, product bullets, CTAs, badges, and other on-site conversion elements



- Run a minimum of two A/B tests per client each month, continuously iterating based on performance insights and learnings



- Maintain a centralized testing log documenting hypotheses, variants, results, learnings, and next-step recommendations across all client accounts



- Identify winning conversion patterns and scalable best practices, then templatize and implement them across the broader client portfolio



- Own and monitor core funnel performance metrics including landing page CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, quiz completion rate, and quiz-to-purchase rate

eting (EOS / Level 10)



**You must have:**

- Experience managing **US multifamily (apartment) properties** — required

- **Hands-on Appfolio experience** — required

- A **proven track record of reliably working US-Eastern hours** — tell me how long you've done it and for whom

- Excellent spoken and written English

- A reliable computer, fast internet, and a quiet place to work and comfortable speaking on phone to tenants, vendors, and fielding leasing and other calls

- Comfort with KPIs and EOS / Level 10 meetings (a plus)



We already have a Filipino tea
mber who has been with us long term — so you wouldn't be the only one figuring out a new foreign boss, you'd be joining a team that already works well together. This is a long-term, stable role with real ownership and room to grow as we expand. We pay well, and we keep our people.

As a vCIO, you are not just a technical expert; you are a strategic partner. You will be responsible for developing long-term IT roadmaps, managing technology budgets, overseeing risk and compliance, and ensuring that every technical investment our clients make drives measurable business value. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of Managed Services (MSP), excellent consultative skills, and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business strategies.

security enhancements.

verticals.

*Budgeting & Financial Management

- Provide Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis for new technology investments.

- Help clients prioritize IT spending based on risk, ROI, and business impact.

*Risk, Security & Compliance

- Oversee client security postures, ensuring alignment with frameworks like NIST, CIS, or industry-specific regulations

(HIPAA, PCI, SOC2).

- Lead Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity (BC) planning and testing.

- Act as a high-level advisor during security i
 or complex technical audits.

*Client Relationship & Account Leadership

- Serve as the primary point of contact for executive-level stakeholders (CEOs, CFOs, Owners).

- Monitor client satisfaction and service delivery trends, working with the technical team to ensure high standards are met.

- Lead the technical onboarding of new high-value clients, setting the strategic foundation from day one.

*Vendor & Project Oversight

- Assist clients in evaluating and managing third-party technology vendors (ISPs, Line-of-Business software, etc.).

- Provide high-level oversight for major infrastructure projects to ensure they stay aligned with the strategic vision.



Qualifications

Required

- Experience: 7–10+ years of experience in IT leadership, senior systems engineering, or IT consulting (MSP experience is highly preferred).

- Strategic Mindset: Proven ability to develop long-term technology strategies that solve real-world business problems.

- Financial Literacy: Comfort managing budgets, performing ROI calculations, and discussing financial impact with executives.

- Communication Excellence: Exceptional ability to present to "C-Suite" executives and translate "geek-speak" into "business-speak."

- Broad Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Microsoft 365, Cloud Infrastructure (Azure/AWS), Networking, and Cybersecurity frameworks.

- Consultative Approach: Strong ability to influence stakeholders and lead through consensus and expertise.



Preferred (Nice to Have)

- Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, PMP, or advanced Microsoft/Cloud certifications).

- Previous experience in a "Fractional CIO" or "Account Lead" role within a technical service organization.



What Success Looks Like in This Role

- Clients view you as an indispensable member of their leadership team, not just a "vendor."

- Client IT environments are stable, secure, and proactively managed according to a documented roadmap.

- Technology spend is predictable for the client, with fewer "emergency" expenses.

- High client retention and growth through trusted, strategic recommendations.



Why Join Us?



We believe in creating an environment where our tea
mbers can thrive both professionally and personally. Here’s what we offer:



*Career Growth: Paid certifications, training, and structured onboarding to help you advance your skills.

*Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary, performance-based incentives (monthly profit share and end-of-year bonus), and 13th-month pay.

*Health & Wellness: Monthly healthcare allowance to support your well-being.

What Sets Us Apart?

mbers.

Hours: Part-time, 4 hours/day, Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM US Eastern (20 hours/week). Content often lands same-day and needs to go live promptly, so reliability in this window is the most important part of this job.



About the role

I run a fast-growing brand in the AI and ecommerce space (YouTube, Instagram, 
). I'm looking for one person to own the publishing side of my content: uploading, scheduling, posting Shorts, light comment moderation, and making sure everything goes out clean and on the right channel.



This is not a "create from scratch" creative role. I'll hand you content and clear guidelines. Your job is to execute them perfectly and ship on time. If you're someone who reads instructions once and follows them exactly, double-checks your own work, and is happy to help with small related tasks without making it a thing, you'll do great here and there's real long-term growth.



What you'll do

-Upload my videos to the correct YouTube channel (I run two, you'll need to be careful which is which, every time)

-Post 2 short-form videos per day to Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, using the correct version for each platform (the files will be labeled, you confirm before posting)

-Schedule and post Instagram Stories when they're ready

-Light comment moderation: reply to common questions using a saved reply bank, delete and block obvious hate or scam comments, forward anything you're unsure about to me

-Occasionally schedule a tweet, a YouTube community post, or a 
 post (spacing and line breaks must be perfect, you always preview before publishing)

-Keep an eye out for content worth repurposing



Must-haves

-Strong, stable internet (this is non-negotiable, you'll be uploading video daily)

-High attention to detail. This is the number 1 thing I'm hiring for. Small misses (wrong channel, broken spacing, wrong version) are what I'm trying to eliminate

-Fast, reliable communication (more on this below)

-Comfortable with YouTube uploading (I'll teach my specifics), Instagram, and basic English for comment replies

-Comfortable using 
 (this is where our team communicates) and generally self-aware online, you don't click sketchy links or engage with fake accounts pretending to be me or my team

-You catch your own mistakes before I have to point them out



Nice to have

-Experience with ManyChat (auto-DM flows)

-Experience managing creator or brand social accounts



Communication expectations (please read)



During your work hours (8 AM to 12 PM EST), I expect you to be 100% responsive and reply quickly, within minutes, not hours, even during slower stretches when there's no active task.



Outside of work hours, including weekends, I don't expect you to do tasks. But if I message you, I do want a quick acknowledgement, something as simple as "got it, I'll handle this Monday." I'm looking for someone who takes ownership and cares about this role, not someone who goes silent until their next shift. Good communication is a big deal to me.



Growth: Once you're in the flow and I trust your judgment (usually after the first month), I'll want you flagging post ideas and content opportunities you spot. The better you get, the more ownership and pay you get.



How to apply (read carefully)

1. Start your message with the word 'SHARP' so I know you read the full post.

title: Part-Time YouTube Video Editor & Shorts Publisher
description:
About the Channel:

The Balloon Boutique Studio is a YouTube channel dedicated to balloon decorating tutorials, event décor inspiration, behind-the-scenes content, and creative business growth. We currently have 7,270+ subscribers and are actively growing toward 10,000 subscribers.



Our audience includes balloon artists, event planners, DIY decorators, creative entrepreneurs, and party enthusiasts.



About the Role:

I am looking for a talented, detail-oriented, and reliable part-time video editor who can take raw long-form footage and transform it into polished, engaging YouTube videos that match the fun, festive, colorful personality of the channel.



Most long-form videos average approximately 11–13 minutes once edited, although some may be shorter or longer depending on the content.



This is an editing-focused role, but it also includes selecting and publishing short-form clips through our Opus Clips subscription. You will work as part of a small content team. For long-form videos, you will edit the finished video and hand it off to the Content Optimizer for final publishing. For Shorts, you will use Opus Clips to identify the strongest clips from published long-form content and publish the selected Shorts to YouTube Shorts and TikTok through the Opus Clips platform.



Projects will be managed through Trello, where assignments, deadlines, checklists, updates, and communication will take place. Raw footage, working files, and final edited assets will be organized through Google Drive. You must be comfortable following a project management workflow and keeping communication organized inside Trello.



This is an ongoing part-time role that averages approximately up to 10 hours per week. The workload may vary from week to week depending on the amount of content. Some weeks may require fewer hours, while other weeks may require more, but the goal is for the workload to average out over time.



Compensation:

This role will begin with a 30-day trial period at a starting project rate of $45 per week, which equals $180 for the first month.



During the first 30 days, you will track the actual time spent on editing and submit your hours along with your weekly invoice. After the first 30 days, we will review the actual workload together and discuss any necessary compensation adjustments so the arrangement remains fair based on the time required.



Please only apply if you are comfortable beginning at the stated 30-day trial rate. This role is not a fit for applicants who are requesting a higher starting rate before the initial 30-day review period.



BONUS Opportunity:

There is also a performance bonus connected to the channel’s growth goal of reaching 10,000 subscribers.



$150 bonus if the channel reaches 10,000 subscribers within 90 days

$100 bonus if the channel reaches 10,000 subscribers within 120 days



Your Responsibilities:



* Edit long-form YouTube tutorial, event, and behind-the-scenes videos from raw footage

* Edit videos with strong pacing, clear storytelling, and a polished viewer experience

* Add captions, lower thirds, and text overlays where needed

* Color grade footage for a warm, vibrant, professional look

* Add background music at appropriate levels without overpowering the original audio

* Clean up audio where needed

* Upload or organize edited long-form videos in the correct Google Drive folder

* Update the appropriate Trello card with progress, questions, completion notes, and final links

* Prepare final edited long-form videos for review and handoff to the Content Optimizer

* Use our Opus Clips subscription to identify the strongest short-form clips from published long-form videos

* Select approximately 2–3 of the strongest Shorts from each applicable long-form video

* Edit Shorts in vertical 9:16 format when needed

* Add captions, text overlays, and simple CTA text where appropriate

* Publish selected Shorts to YouTube Shorts and TikTok through the Opus Clips platform

* Paste final Short links into the correct Trello card

* Deliver work within the agreed deadlines

* Communicate clearly when a project is complete or ready for review

* Make revisions based on feedback



You Are the Right Fit If You:



* Have prior video editing experience

* Have experience editing YouTube content, preferably tutorial, lifestyle, educational, or creative content

* Have a portfolio of long-form YouTube videos you have edited

* Understand pacing, storytelling, retention, and clean visual presentation

* Are proficient in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar editing software

* Have experience creating, selecting, or publishing Shorts from long-form content

* Are comfortable using Opus Clips or willing to learn the workflow quickly

* Are comfortable working inside Trello and Google Drive

* Have a strong eye for color, timing, audio levels, and visual flow

* Are reliable, communicative, and able to meet deadlines consistently

* Can work independently with minimal supervision

* Have a pleasant, professional attitude and are easy to work with

* Are comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions promptly

* Enjoy working with creative, colorful, and fun content



This Role Is NOT a Fit If You:



* Are brand new to video editing with no examples of completed work

* Do not have portfolio links or samples to share

* Are unable to meet agreed deadlines

* Have difficulty receiving feedback or making revisions

* Are requesting a higher starting rate before the 30-day review period

* Prefer to work without structure, communication, or clear deadlines

* Are not willing to use Trello and Google Drive as part of the workflow

* If you are not detail-oriented and don't follow directions



Requirements:



* Minimum 1 year of video editing experience preferred

* YouTube editing experience strongly preferred

* Stable internet connection

* Own computer with video editing software

* Comfortable using Trello for project updates, deadlines, and communication

* Comfortable using Google Drive to access footage and organize final files

* Available for a weekly check-in via Zoom or Messenger

* Able to track and submit hours weekly during the first 30-day trial period

* Able to follow deadlines and communicate early if anything may be delayed

* Able to receive feedback professionally and make revisions as needed

* Must be dependable, organized, and pleasant to work with



Revision Policy:

Each video includes up to two rounds of revisions. Additional revision requests beyond that will be discussed on a case-by-case basis.



Interview Process:

The interview process has two phases.



Phase 1: Application and Portfolio Review

I will review your resume, video samples, editing experience, portfolio links, and overall fit for the channel.



Phase 2: Short Interview and Workflow Discussion

Selected applicants will be invited to a short Zoom or Messenger conversation to discuss availability, editing process, communication style, deadlines, Trello/Google Drive workflow, and whether this is a good fit for both sides.



To Apply:

Please send the following:



* Your resume

* Links to at least 2 YouTube videos you have edited

* A brief note telling me why you are the right fit for this channel

* Your available start date

* The video editing software you use

* Any experience you have with Opus Clips, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Trello, or Google Drive



**Important:**

Place the words **“MAKE IT POP”** in the subject line of your application.



Applications that do not include **“MAKE IT POP”** in the subject line will not be considered. Applications without portfolio links will also not be considered.



Please apply through this platform only. Applicants who contact us outside of this platform, including through social media, personal pages,
, or other direct messages, will automatically be disqualified from consideration.

title: Full Time for Copywriter For Personal Brand
description:
**Company:** Black Swan Media / Digital Wealth Lab

**Reports to:** Head Copywriter

**Type:** Full-time

**Hours:** Monday–Friday, 4:00 AM – 12:00 PM US Eastern

**Compensation:** Competitive, based on experience



**About us**



We run Digital Wealth Lab - a mentorship teaching corporate professionals how to build AI marketing businesses serving local businesses. The brand 
 is built on one promise: show people the exact system, no hype, no guru theater. We produce high-performing Instagram content at scale, powered by AI but shaped by real copywriting taste. You'd join a small, senior team where your work ships every day and the numbers are visible.



**The role**



You'll write Instagram carousels (and reels down the line) for Bruno's personal brand. Your job is to produce copy that stops the scroll, drives DMs, and turns attention into qualified leads — in Bruno's voice, not yours.



You'll use our AI content system to move fast, but the words are on you. You write the hooks, shape the emotional arc, polish every line, and make sure each post lands before it ships. Over time you help sharpen the system and the brand voice itself.



**What you'll do**



- Write daily carousels and reels in Bruno's voice

- Use our AI content system to draft fast, then edit and rewrite at the sentence level until it ships

- Craft hooks that stop the scroll and CTAs that drive DMs

- QA every post against the brand voice, the format specs, and our content guidelines

- Hand off finished copy to designers and video editors with clear briefs

- Track what's working, what's failing, what's getting flagged

- Feed learnings back into the system so the content gets sharper every week

- Own the lead and growth numbers from organic IG content



**Core skills required**



1. **Influencer / creator experience.** Required. You've written for or worked closely with influencers, coaches, or personal brands — ideally in the business-opportunity, finance, or self-improvement space. You know what creator content sounds like and how it performs.



2. **Social media posting experience.** Required. You've run the day-to-day of posting on Instagram — carousels, reels, captions, timing, hashtags. You understand the platform from the inside, not just in theory.



3. **Copywriting.** Non-negotiable. You write hooks that land, you understand why one slide converts and another dies, and you can shape a full post that pulls a reader from the first slide to the CTA. You write tight, simple, and persuasive — no fluff, no guru hype.



4. **Marketing.** You think in funnels, hooks, offers, and conversion — not just engagement. You can read a piece of content and tell whether it's built to grow followers, generate leads, or sell, and you know when to use which.



5. **AI prompting.** You use Claude or GPT to draft and move faster, you iterate when an output is weak, and you push back instead of accepting the first draft. The AI speeds you up — your judgment is what makes it good.



**Bonus (not required, strong plus)**



- Theme page / shoutout space

- Coaching and info-product space (biz op, high-ticket, masterminds)

- Personal brand work for a creator with 100k+ followers

- Funnels that turn IG attention into DMs, booked calls, or sales

- Ghostwriting or voice-matching — writing in a brand voice that isn't yours



**Do not apply if**



- Your instinct is to write in your own voice over the brand's. The voice belongs to Bruno. Your job is to write copy indistinguishable from him writing it himself.

- You can't tell a good hook from a bad one without overthinking it. Taste is the job.

- You've never run or written for a real social media account.

- You can't commit to the 4 AM – 12 PM US Eastern schedule, Monday–Friday.

- You do not have real results from previous clients - this is not an entry level position. Seriously, do not waste our time unless you are 100% confident that you are an elite copywriter



---



**Application Process**



**Please read before applying:** Applicants who do not complete and submit the test task will not be considered — no exceptions. Everyone who does submit the full task is guaranteed a response from us, whether it's a yes or a no.



**Step 1: Loom Video / Video Introduction**



As the next step, please share a 5-minute Loom video or a recording from any video app introducing yourself and walking us through why you're a strong fit for this role.



In your video, please cover:



- Who you are and your relevant experience

- Why this role interests you

- Why you believe you're the right fit

- How you currently use AI in your work

- Any examples of similar work you've done, especially writing for influencers or personal brands and using AI to create or scale content

- How your experience connects to the responsibilities described in the job description



Please keep the video focused, clear, and relevant to the role.



**Step 2: Task**



**Part 1** — Go through Bruno's profile (
;. Conduct research on Instagram. Come up with 5 post ideas (hooks + post outline) that would fit Bruno's content strategy.



You DO NOT need to write the full carousel/reel for this part.



Example of an idea:



*Hook:*

At 20 I was working a 9-5 making $52k. I failed 6 businesses over the next 4 years. Everyone around me thought I was done. Then one boring AI tool changed everything.



*Post outline:*

Use Bruno's story and the exact system he followed to explain how the AI marketing business works. Use specific numbers, named tools, and the math that closes (tool cost vs. what the client pays).



**Part 2** — Write the full carousel for 2 of the ideas you created in Part 1. You're welcome to use Claude or another AI tool to draft, but we want to see your copywriting — the final words should be polished by you.



If you used AI, please attach the transcript of your chat so we can see your prompting approach and how you shaped the output. You have 24–48 hours to share your submission once you receive the document.



**Submission**



Please submit the following:



- Your 5-minute Loom/video link

- Your 5 hooks and carousel ideas

- The 2 full carousels you wrote

- The transcript of your AI chat (if you used one)



Thank you again for applying. We're looking forward to reviewing your submission and learning more about how you work.

title: Operations & Growth Partner
description:
WHAT IS OUTDOORBENGAL



OutdoorBengal exists to help cat parents do more (and better) with their cats. You can find more about the company and Albert´s story at We make adventure cat gear and training tools for the people who think of their cat as family, not furniture. We’re a small, profitable, fast-growing team. We sell mostly online (Amazon and our own website), and we’re scaling quickly: ~70% growth on Amazon and roughly 10x on our website over the last year.



Right now, we are a small team of 4 people: Albert (founder, operations, marketing, and most things in between), Neus (product and innovation), Pave (product and innovation, reporting to Neus), and Jemar (graphic design).



Customer
s, demand planning, re-routing orders, growth opportunities… they all flow through one inbox, and most days, the urgent crowds out the important.

That’s where you come in.



WHAT IS THE ROLE



You will take operational work off the founder’s plate so the business can grow. Over time, as we earn trust together, you’ll grow into the work that creates growth.



We’re looking for one person, long-term, who wants to grow with us. Not a contractor. Not a task-rabbit. A partner in the early-stage, hands-dirty sense of the word. Here’s how the role grows:



Phase 1 — Foundation (Months 1–6)



In your first six months, your job is to take three things off Albert’s plate, completely, and own them better than he did.

1. Customer service
s.

You will be the voice of OutdoorBengal. This is a very important job. Cat parents are passionate, and the way we respond to them is the way we earn their trust for life. You’ll learn our products inside out, develop a tone that sounds like us (warm, direct, knowledgeable), and over time build the playbooks that turn a one-time buyer into someone who tells their friends.

2. Financial and demand planning reports.

You’ll own the cadence of our internal reports — sales, inventory, demand forecasts — pulling data from Amazon, Shopify, and our spreadsheets, keeping it clean, and flagging anomalies before they become problems. We make decisions based on these numbers. Accuracy and timeliness are non-negotiable.

3. Order rerouting and exception handling.

When orders go sideways — wrong address, lost shipments, fulfillment hiccups — you make them right. Quickly, following the blueprint, with judgment when needed, and without escalating every decision.

If you nail Phase 1, you’ll have done something rare: you’ll have given the founder back his time. That’s the first half of the job.



Phase 2 — Growth (Month 6 onward, conditional on Phase 1)



Once the foundation is solid and trust is established, the role expands into growth work:

1. PR outreach — pitching the brand to publications, podcasts, and blogs in the cat and outdoor spaces.

2. Influencer outreach — finding, contacting, and building relationships with cat influencers and creators who can put our products in front of new audiences.

3. CRM management — owning the
/SMS lifecycle, segmentation, automation, and the relationship with our subscribers.



To be clear: Phase 2 is not guaranteed. If you turn out to be excellent at operations but not a fit for outreach work, that’s fine. We’ll figure out together what’s next. But we are intentionally hiring someone with the ceiling to do both, and we’ll pay accordingly when you grow into it.



WHO YOU ARE



We don’t care about your degree. We care that you are:

- A clear, warm writer in English. You’ll write hundreds of customer
s. You should be able to be kind, specific, and brief (without sounding like a corporate FAQ or an AI Agent).

- Numerate and careful. Spreadsheets don't intimidate you. You can run VLOOKUPs, SUMIFS, and pivot tables — and you'll learn whatever else the work requires. You catch your own mistakes before someone else does, and you respect the difference between 5% and 0.5%.

- Curious and a self-starter with judgment. When you spot something not quite right, you dig deeper to try to find an answer. If you don’t know what to do, you find out. When something feels off, you flag it. You don’t need to be told twice.

- Hungry. Self-motivated, diligent, always looking for more. You go beyond the job description without being asked. Comfortable with both freedom and structure. (Some weeks are process, some are chaos, and you're at home in both.)

- Humble in the truest sense. Willing to learn, willing to admit when you got it wrong. You believe humans never peak, and great work can always be better.

- Long-term oriented. We’re not looking for someone for the next six months. We’re looking for someone for the next five years. Pave has been with us 3 years, Jemar 2. We’re building a team and looking for a great teammate.



WHAT'S HELPFUL (Not Required)



- Prior experience in customer service, e-commerce operations, or VA work for a founder.

- Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central, Shopify, and Excel sheets at an intermediate level.

- Experience with PR or influencer outreach in any category — bonus if it’s pets, outdoors, or DTC consumer goods.

- ChatGPT/AI literacy. We use it. You should, too. It’s as important to master it as it is not to sound like a robot because of it.



WHAT "Good" LOOKS LIKE IN 90 DAYS



- Customer
 response time under 24 hours, with a tone that matches our brand.

- Weekly financial and demand reports delivered on time, with no errors for Albert to catch.

- Order exceptions handled end-to-end without Albert in the loop on routine cases.

- You’ve documented your own SOPs as you go to make the playbook stronger and reduce guesswork.



If those four things are true at the 90-day mark, we are in business together.



HOW DO WE WORK



- Remote and async-friendly. You set your own hours within reason. We don’t micromanage your day.

- Hubstaff for hours and accountability. We use Hubstaff to track working hours and take periodic screen recordings while you’re on the clock. We’re upfront about this because we’d rather you know than feel watched. In practice, we rarely review the recordings. They exist as a baseline of trust and a paper trail, not as a surveillance tool. You log your hours; we pay against them.

- Direct feedback, both ways. We tell you when something’s off; we want you to tell us the same. The fastest way to lose trust here is to tell us what we want to hear.

 -Long-term win-win. We want you to grow. We want you to be paid well. We want you to be here in five years. If any of that stops being true on either side, we talk about it openly.

- Tools you’ll use regularly: Asana, WhatsApp, Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Etsy Seller Central, Excel, and Hubstaff.



COMPENSATION 



We pay well for the right person. We will tell you specifically what we’re offering once we know who you are and what you bring, but the range is competitive for the role and the trajectory, and it grows as your scope grows. If money is your only filter, we are probably not the right fit. If trajectory + money + meaning is your filter, let’s talk.



HOW TO APPLY



Send an
 to 
 with:

- A short note (3–5 paragraphs, not a cover letter template) telling us who you are, why this role caught your attention, and what you’d want to be doing in three years if this works out.

- A link to your CV or LinkedIn.

- Answers to these two questions:

1. Tell us about something you got wrong at work in the last year. What happened, what did you do, and what did you learn?

2. What's something you've taught yourself in the last year (work-related or not), and how did you go about it? 



We read every application. We only respond to applications that have “Operations Growth Partner - btw, I love your cat” as the
 subject.



OUR PROCESS



We don’t hire from interviews alone. Here’s how we choose:

- Application review. We read your
 and your answers. If we like what we see, we move you to the next round.

- Paid tasks. Shortlisted candidates are asked to complete three small, paid tasks: two real-world customer service
s and one Excel/Google Sheets tracker. These mirror the actual work of Phase 1. We pay for your time whether or not we move forward together.

- Interview. A conversation with Albert (and Neus, depending on schedules). We’ll talk about your tasks, your background, and how you think.

Vertical short-form portfolio

title: Remote Copywriter (Presentation & Webinar Scripts)
description:
If you enjoy building high-converting webinar presentations, following a clear, systematic process, and using AI to scale your writing, keep reading.



About us:

We’re the Creade Club. We coach Sport-Creators to benefit more from their audience. Clients are mostly successful Sport-Creators who are having trouble improving their business further.



We’re now hiring a Remote Webinar Copywriter to help us build high-converting presentations for our clients. The job is creative but systematic: you don't invent decks from scratch; you adapt a proven structure to each client. Your focus is strictly on the text/copy—the words on each slide. You are not designing anything. We do this work using Claude AI, so the whole build runs as a guided process inside a Claude project.



What you’ll do:

- Run guided AI workflows

- Adapt proven structures

- Manage slide tiers

- Define key variables

- Perfect the pacing

- You are not designing



What we provide:

- Detailed client intake forms containing all the raw material you need.

- Structural wireframes (marked with evergreen and near-evergreen identifiers) to act as your map.

- Starter prompts to load into Claude AI to initiate the build smoothly.

- Examples of high-converting presentations to reference for pacing and structural adaptation.



You’re a fit if:

- You know when to write fresh copy and when to leave proven "evergreen" assets alone.

- You understand how to pace a presentation for speaking, using sentence fragments rather than paragraphs.

- You have excellent editorial judgment and can synthesize a client's core promise into a highly effective opening "Hook."

- You enjoy directing and refining AI outputs rather than writing every single word from a blank page.



Requirements:

Strong editorial and copywriting skills, specifically for spoken presentations or webinars.

Comfortable operating workflows within AI platforms like Claude.

Available for team communication and questions between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM German time (your actual working hours are flexible).

Strong written and spoken English.

Reliable internet, a working computer, a webcam, and a quiet place to work.



How to apply: 

This is a short form where we ask about your experience, portfolio (please include copywriting or presentation examples), and availability.



If it looks like a potential fit on paper, we’ll offer you an assessment task to test how you run our Claude workflow.



Top candidates from the assessment task will be invited to a short 1:1 call and a paid trial period.

title: Product & Category Analyst / Market Research Specialist
description:
E-commerce on Bol · Remote · 3–4 days a week to start, growing as the role does



We're a Dutch e-commerce business selling on the Bol marketplace, and we're growing fast. A big part of that growth comes down to one hard question, asked over and over: what should we launch next, and what should we leave alone? 

Most people get this wrong. They chase trends, ignore the margin, and miss the products that quietly print money. 

We're looking for the person who gets it right more often than not.



This isn't a research-assistant job. 

You won't be filling in sheets someone else acts on. 

You'll be the one finding the opportunities, weighing them honestly, and putting your name to a recommendation. 

You'd work directly with me, the founder, alongside our data analyst and purchasing team. 

You bring the thinking, we d
 together, and you watch your calls play out in the business.



What you'd be doing

There are three sides to this role.



Finding new products to launch. This is the heart of the job. We aim to launch around five new product keywords a month (each one usually having 2-3 SKUs). 

You'd hunt for those opportunities, run them through clear criteria, and bring me a short, well-argued case for each one worth pursuing. 

You'd also check the sourcing data our purchasing team gathers, so we're confident the numbers behind a launch actually hold up.



Growing what we already sell. 

Looking at our existing products and finding ways to do better, a smart addition to a product family, a sharper price, better quality, a stronger look. 

You'd spot where we can extend or improve an offer and make the case for it.



Trends and seasonality. 

Keeping an eye on where the market's heading, and working closely with our data analyst to flag seasonal swings before they hit, Q4 build-ups, summer or winter spikes on certain SKUs, and which categories are growing or shrinking year on year. 

Your job is to make sure we're never caught off guard on timing.





How we think about a good product

We have criteria, and part of your job is to apply them sharply: enough demand to be worth it, competition we can realistically beat, and margin that still works after all marketplace costs and sourcing. Those are the filters. 

The judgment, which of the products that clear those filters is actually worth launching, is the part we're hiring you for. 

We can teach you our thresholds. 

We can't teach instinct, so that's what we'll be looking for, and we'll know quickly whether you have it.



Who we're hoping to find

Real e-commerce and marketplace research experience. (at least 3 years / preferably 5+) 

You've done product research for an online business before, ideally on a marketplace like Bol, Amazon, or similar marketplaces. 

You understand how demand, competition, reviews, pricing, and fulfilment costs come together to make a product win or lose.

Judgment that's been proven, not just claimed. 

Anyone can pull numbers and call something "trending." We need someone who looks at a category and knows which gap is a real opportunity and which is a trap that'll cost us money. 

If you've actually launched or recommended products that worked, that's what we want to hear about.



Comfortable with the tools. 

Bol's own data, marketplace research tools (Helium 10, Keepa, or similar specific for Bol like Marktmentor), and AI tools for speeding up research and analysis. 

If you already lean on AI to work faster and sharper, you'll fit right in.



A close collaborator. 

You'll work hand in hand with our data analyst and purchasing team, so you need to communicate clearly and share what you find in a way others can act on.

Fully fluent English, happy working remotely with a few hours of daily overlap with European time.



What you get out of it

-Real ownership. You're not a research assistant filling sheets, you own product discovery and shape what we launch. Your work is visible in the business fast.



-A direct line to the founder. You bring the opportunities, we d
 together, and you see your calls play out.



-Room to grow. This starts at 3–4 days a week and can grow with the company as our launch pace picks up.



-A company that invests in you. We're built on quality, in our products, our service, and the life of our team. We back that with a monthly health bonus you can put toward whatever keeps you well, gym, better sleep, whatever works for you.



-Remote, wherever you are, with just a few hours of daily overlap with European time.



-USD $15 an hour to start, with real room to move up as you prove yourself.





How to apply

Skip the long CV for now. Instead, I'd like to see how you actually work.



Pick any product category you like and find me three products you'd consider worth launching on a marketplace. 



For each one, tell me briefly why, what makes you think there's a real opportunity, and what would make you nervous about it. 

I'm not expecting it to match our business perfectly, I want to see how you spot and weigh an opportunity.



Then tell me a little about your background in e-commerce research, and what made you want this role specifically.



One last thing. 

We're after real A-players, and A-players like to work with other A-players. 

So if you've read this and thought "yes, this is me", apply. I'm looking forward to seeing what you find.

At our company, every business problem is first analyzed with numbers.

? "Reply rate dropped from 4.2% to 1.8% week-over-week, likely caused by the subject line change on Tuesday." — this IS analysis.

title: Freelance Inventory Planner — Ecommerce
description:
Hi! We are a fast-growing Dutch premium ecommerce brand selling scented products online. We are scaling quickly and need someone who can help us stay on top of our inventory, so we never run out of stock.



What this job is:

- We are looking for a freelance inventory planner who can build a forecasting system and give us weekly advice on our stock levels.

- This is not a supply chain management role. You will not contact suppliers. You will not place orders. We handle all of that ourselves.



Your job is simple:

- Receive data from us (Shopify exports, current stock levels, lead time updates)

- Build a model that calculates when we need to reorder each product

- Tell us what to order, how much, and when, before we run out



Phase 1 — Build the system (first 2–4 weeks, approximately 8–10 hours per week)

- Aalyse our currect system

- Map all our products and current stock levels

- Analyze sales velocity per SKU

- Build a reorder model in Excel or Google Sheets (or something like that) that calculates reorder points, safety stock, and projected stock-out dates

- Account for variable supplier lead times, we will always tell you when lead times change

- Deliver a clean, easy-to-read dashboard that shows us what action to take each week

- Document everything so we always understand the model



Phase 2 — Ongoing management (after setup, approximately 2–4 hours per week)**

- Update the forecast 1–2 times per week based on our latest sales data

- Send us a short weekly update: what needs to be ordered, what is at risk, what is fine

- Adjust forecasts when we inform you about upcoming sales, promotions, or lead time changes

- Keep the model accurate and up to date



Important: We always inform you about any changes that affect inventory: new sales campaigns, changed lead times, new products. You take that input and update the forecast accordingly.



What we are looking for

- Experience in inventory planning or demand forecasting for an ecommerce or product-based business

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills — you must be comfortable building formulas, reorder models, and dashboards

- Experience working with Shopify data (sales reports, inventory exports)

- Clear and structured communicator — your weekly update must be simple and direct, not a complex report

- Reliable and proactive — you flag risks before they become problems



AI and automation bonus

We actively reward smart use of AI tools. If you can automate parts of the forecasting process — for example using AI to process Shopify exports, generate forecast updates, or flag reorder 
nts automatically — you will be compensated better for it. Tell us in your application what you have automated before and how.



Tools we currently use

- Excel with manual Shopify exports

- You may propose a better system if you have experience with tools like Inventory Planner, Stocky, or similar, but Excel or Google Sheets is fine



Practical details

- Freelance, part-time, fully remote

- Phase 1: approximately 8–10 hours per week for 2–4 weeks

- Phase 2: approximately 2–4 hours per week, ongoing

- Pay: will be discussed based of the workload

- Pay is bi-weekly or monthly



---



How to apply — read this carefully

To submit a valid application, your message must include all four of the following:



1. Start your message with the word: REORDER,  applications that do not start with this word will not be reviewed



2. Describe one specific inventory or forecasting system you have built before — what was the business, what did you build, and what tool did you use



3. Tell us which tools you currently work with most (Excel, Google Sheets, Inventory Planner, or other)



4. Tell us in 1–2 sentences: what is the biggest risk when a fast-growing ecommerce brand does not have a proper reorder system?



4. Tell us how you would use AI o build the system or automate certain processes?



Applications that do not follow these instructions will be skipped automatically.

Stylized Animation: Engaging, visually striking, and creative AI-animated narratives.

Hyper-Realistic AI Influencers: Content featuring lifelike AI characters that look and behave like real people, focused on community and authentic lifestyle niches.

Prompt Engineering: Ability to write clear, descriptive English text prompts that focus strictly on characters and specific actions to achieve accurate, high-quality visual outputs.



Cinematographic Eye: Strong understanding of framing, narrative pacing, lighting, and visual continuity across multiple AI-generated clips.



Attention to Detail: Ability to spot and correct visual anomalies, maintaining consistency for our AI influencer personas and animated characters across scenes.

title: Expert Media Buyer - Google Ads & Meta Ads : 400 - 800 USD/mo - Facebook &amp
description:
OVERVIEW



RMD is a digital agency with clients in 20+ countries. We're hiring a Media Buyer to own paid acquisition on Google Ads and Meta Ads -
 & Instagram ads -, from setup to the part most people skip: making the campaigns actually work.



This is not a "launch it and check back next week" seat. We need someone who treats every account like their own money is in it. You build the campaign, yes, but more importantly you read the numbers every day, find what's leaking, and fix it before the client has to ask.



This is also not a junior seat where we hold your hand. We want someone ahead of us on paid media. Someone who teaches the team, raises the standard, and keeps learning every single day on their own. If you're the kind of person who gets uncomfortable when a campaign is spending without a clear answer on why it's converting (or why it isn't), this is for you.



Compensation: $400 to $800 USD per month based on experience and proven results, paid via PayPal. Top performers move up fast. See the pay-growth section below.



Hours: 40 hours per week, Manila time. We need 4 hours of overlap with Morocco/Dubai (so a 1pm to 9pm or 2pm to 10pm Manila shift is ideal).



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Plan, build, and launch Google Ads (Search, PMax, Demand Gen) and Meta Ads (Advantage+, traffic/conversion campaigns) from a brief, with clean account structure, correct conversion goals, and sane budgets

- Create clear, detailed briefs for ad creatives — concept, angle, hook, format, copy direction, and reference — so designers and video editors can execute without guessing

- Strategize for clients, not just execute. Own the account-level plan: funnel structure, offer/angle testing roadmap, budget allocation across channels, and where to scale next

- Run benchmarks. Pull and track performance against industry and account baselines (CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPM, CVR) so every result has a "good vs. bad" reference, not a number in a vacuum

- Own performance daily. Watch spend, CPA, ROAS, CTR, conversion rate, and frequency. Catch problems within hours, not at month-end

- Run campaigns in multiple languages. Our clients span Morocco, Dubai, France, and beyond. You use AI and translation tools to localize ad copy, keywords, and audiences quickly and correctly, then sanity-check the output before it goes live

- Set up and verify tracking properly: Meta Pixel + Conversions API, Google Ads conversion tracking, GA4 events, consent mode v2, and confirm the data is actually firing and matching, not "the pixel is green, ship it"

- Run weekly account-health checks: disapproved ads, broken conversion tracking, audience overlap, budget pacing, wasted spend on junk placements and search terms. Flag what you find with a recommendation, not just a list

- Write the analysis. Every report answers: what happened, why, what you're doing about it, what you need from us. No vanity metrics. We don't care about impressions and "engagement" if the leads or sales aren't moving

- Build and follow repeatable processes: launch checklists, naming conventions, weekly optimization routines, reporting templates. If you do something twice, it should become a documented process

- Run structured tests: creative tests, audience tests, bid strategy tests, landing page angle tests. One variable, clear hypothesis, real read on the result

- Manage budgets responsibly and scale what works without torching CPA

- Teach the team. Share what you know, document your playbooks, and level up the people around you

- Communicate async, in writing, with the numbers attached



WHAT YOU NEED ON DAY ONE



The floor on this role is real. You walk in with these or you don't walk in.



- 2+ years managing live Google Ads AND Meta Ads accounts. Not a course, not a sandbox. Real accounts with real spend that you were responsible for and held accountable for

- You are genuinely analytical and great with numbers. You can look at a performance table and immediately see where the money is going wrong. CPA, ROAS, CTR, CVR, CPM, frequency, AOV are not jargon to you, they're the tools you think with

- You can write ad creative briefs and set creative direction. You know what makes a hook stop the scroll and can brief a designer or editor so they execute without guessing

- You think strategy, not just execution. You can build an account-level plan: funnel, offers/angles to test, budget split across channels, and a clear point of view on where to scale

- Pixel and conversion tracking setup. Meta Pixel + Conversions API, Google Ads conversion tags, GA4. You've installed them, debugged them, and confirmed events fire correctly (Events Manager, Tag Assistant, GA4 DebugView)

- Consent Mode v2 experience. You understand why it matters for EU tracking and have implemented or worked with it

- You create and follow processes. You don't rely on memory. You build checklists and routines and you stick to them

- You run ads in multiple languages. You're comfortable using AI and translation tools to localize campaigns for different markets, and you know how to check that the localized copy is actually good and not robotic

- Recent performance screenshots are a MUST. Send real, recent (last 6 months) screenshots from Ads Manager, Google Ads, or GA4 showing accounts you managed: spend, CPA/ROAS, results over time. Redacted client names are fine. No screenshots, no shortlist

- Killer analysis, not vanity metrics. When you send those screenshots, tell us the story: what was broken, what you changed, what happened. "We lowered CPA from $42 to $19 by cutting X and restructuring Y" beats "we got 2M impressions"

- You care about client results like an owner. You're not satisfied when the campaign is "running." You're satisfied when it's winning. People who set up campaigns and walk away are not who we want

- You self-train every day. Paid media changes constantly. Platforms ship updates, policies shift, what worked last quarter dies. We expect you to do your own daily learning to stay ahead, not wait for us to teach you. You should be the one bringing new tactics to the table

- You read English well. Our briefs and reports are in English

- Honesty about what you don't know. "I haven't run PMax much, but I've run a lot of Search and I learn fast" beats "yes I know everything" followed by a blown budget



BONUS (NOT REQUIRED, BUT MOVES YOU UP THE LIST)



- An account where you can show a clear before/after: CPA down, ROAS up, or scale without losing efficiency, with the GA4/Ads Manager screenshots to prove it

- Experience scaling an account past $10K/month in spend profitably

- E-commerce / Shopify paid media (we have e-commerce clients)

- Lead-gen experience with offline/CRM conversion tracking

- Server-side tracking (sGTM, CAPI Gateway) experience

- Google Tag Manager fluency

- French (we have clients in France and North Africa)

- Comfortable recording Loom walkthroughs of an account to explain your thinking async



WHO WE ARE



A small team distributed across Morocco and Dubai. We work in writing, async-first, and we trust people to ship and to own the number.



We use AI in the daily work, in media buying, in copy, and in translation. We expect you to use it too, fluently, after onboarding. The test for this role does not allow AI, because we need to see how YOU read an account and make decisions.



WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH IT (read this part carefully)



This is a seat with a high ceiling for someone who is already strong and keeps getting stronger. Here's what that means:



- You will get to do more, fast. If you can build clean campaigns and actually move the numbers, we hand you more accounts, bigger budgets, and a real say in strategy. We don't make good media buyers babysit one account forever.

- We reward results. Drop a CPA, scale a winning account, save a campaign we thought was dead, and we adjust your pay and scope to match. We don't make people wait 2 years for a real raise. A-players see significant pay growth (50% to 80%+) inside the first year.

- You set the standard, and we back it. We want someone who pushes us forward on paid media, brings us new tactics, and teaches the team. If you do that, you get more ownership, not more oversight.

- The ceiling is what you make of it. Our best media buyers grow into account strategists and paid media leads who own client relationships and budgets. You d
 how fast.



Who this is NOT for: people who set up a campaign, send a screenshot of impressions, and call it a day. People who get nervous reading a numbers table. People who wait to be taught instead of teaching themselves. If comfortable, low-pressure, and no growth is the goal, this isn't the seat. Apply somewhere else, no hard feelings.



HOW TO APPLY



- Reply with your CV

- Include recent performance screenshots (last 6 months) from accounts you've managed: Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and/or GA4. Show spend and results over time. Redacted client/brand names are fine. This is required, not optional

- Start your
 body with the line: RMD RMD. (Yes, exactly those two words on the first line. This is how we know you actually read the post.)

- In the
, confirm you read this full brief and confirm the exact monthly pay you're looking for (in USD). Be specific, not a range

- Tell us in 2 to 3 sentences: what's the most recent account you managed? What was broken or underperforming, what did you change, and what was the measurable result?

- If your application makes our shortlist, we send you a free 45-minute practical test (we'll show you the scoring before you start). Expect to read a real account's numbers and tell us what you'd do

- We reply within 5 business days if we want to move you forward. We're a small team with no dedicated recruiter. If you don't hear from us in that window, it wasn't a fit this round. Don't take it personally and please don't chase. We respect your time enough to be honest about that.



WHAT NOT TO SEND



- A CV with no performance screenshots

- Vanity metrics (impressions, reach, "engagement") with no link to leads or sales

- "I am hardworking and loyal" cover letters with no numbers

- Promises that you can do everything and scale anything (we know nobody can)



We're hiring one person for this role. We're patient. We will wait for the right fit.



Apply on OnlineJobs.ph or
 
 with subject "Media Buyer PH, [Your Full Name]"
