title: SEO Specialist
description:
Type: Full-Time

Hours: Must overlap with US Eastern Time business hours (Ocala, FL)

Reports to: Founder / CEO



About Ghost Engine Digital

Ghost Engine Digital is a US-based digital marketing agency serving home services and trades businesses, landscapers, roofers, plumbers, irrigation contractors, and more. We get our clients found through high-performing websites, local SEO, Google Business Profile management, and paid ads. We run on documented systems, not guesswork, and we measure success by real results: rankings, calls, and booked jobs.



The Role

We're hiring a full-time SEO Specialist to execute organic and local search work across a portfolio of client accounts. This is a hands-on, execution-heavy role, you'll manage 6–15 active accounts at once, so you must be organized, fast, and comfortable working inside clearly defined processes.

You won't be left guessing. We work from a documented SOP library written in plain English, covering keyword research, on-page optimization, technical SEO, and local search. Your job is to follow those SOPs precisely, keep every account moving forward, and flag clearly when something isn't working.



What You'll Do

• Execute SEO and local search tasks across 6–15 client accounts, mostly home services and trades.

• Conduct keyword research in SEMrush (Pro + Local Toolkit) and map keywords to client pages following our SOP.

• Optimize on-page elements: titles, meta descriptions, headers, internal links, content structure, and schema.

• Write and edit SEO content, including rewriting thin pages and consolidating overlapping content.

• Manage Google Business Profiles — optimization, posting, Q&A, review tracking, and fixing visibility issues.

• Manage citations and listings (SEMRush Local) and support backlink/outreach tasks.

• Handle technical SEO tasks: Google Search Console checks (404s, indexation, canonicals), site health passes, and basic page speed/Core Web Vitals work.

• Track rankings, traffic, and conversions, and prepare clean reports that connect SEO work to leads.

• Make on-page edits and publish content in WordPress (Astra/Elementor).

• Document your work clearly so accounts stay consistent and nothing falls through the cracks.



What You Need

2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, ideally agency-side or managing multiple client accounts.

Real local SEO experience: Google Business Profile, citations, reviews, and local pack rankings.

Working knowledge of SEMrush (or similar), Google Search Console, and Google Analytics.

Solid understanding of technical SEO basics — indexation, canonicals, redirects, schema, page speed.

Comfortable working in WordPress for on-page edits and publishing.

Strong written English. You'll be writing content and reporting to US clients, so clear, professional English is required.

Highly organized — able to juggle 10+ accounts without dropping tasks. Time management is non-negotiable.

Self-directed and process-driven. You can follow an SOP exactly and speak up when something's off.

Reliable high-speed internet, a backup connection, and a computer that can run multiple tools at once.

Able to work consistent hours overlapping US Eastern Time.



Nice to Have

Experience with home services / trades clients.

Familiarity with GoHighLevel (GHL)/Automations.

Basic Google Ads understanding.

Experience following or building SEO SOPs.



To Apply

Send your resume, a short note on your local SEO experience, and one example of an account where you improved rankings or leads. Tell us the most accounts you've managed at once and how you stayed organized. Include a sample of SEO content you've written in English.

title: Amazon Marketplace Specialist - Wholesale / Online Arbitrage

- Sales Planning: Recommend products to test, quantity to purchase, fulfillment method when relevant, and when to replenish based on sales velocity and available capital.

- Reporting: Provide weekly updates on product leads, supplier outreach, approval status, purchase recommendations, inventory status, and sales performance.



WHAT YOU DON’T NEED TO DO

- Daily customer service

- Daily order tracking

- Manual fulfillment tasks, unless coordination is needed with our team



REQUIREMENTS

- Proven experience with Amazon Wholesale, Online Arbitrage, or related Amazon resale work

- Strong understanding of Keepa, Seller Central, Buy Box, sales rank, Amazon fees, and Amazon profitability

- Experience with ungating, brand approval, or category approval

- Experience contacting suppliers, distributors, brands, or sourcing from online retailers

- Ability to calculate ROI, margin, profit, break-even price, sales velocity, and recommended purchase quantity

- Ability to identify risky brands, restricted products, hazmat, meltable items, and IP complaint risks

- Strong English communication skills, especially for supplier outreach

- Able to work independently and collaborate with our team

- Reliable internet connection and quiet workspace

- Able to work 9am-6pm Hong Kong / PH time (you will need to job in our team 
 during working hour)



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience opening wholesale accounts

- Existing knowledge of reliable US distributors, wholesalers, online sourcing sites, or prep centers

- Experience managing multiple Amazon accounts or client accounts

- Experience with InventoryLab, ScanUnlimited, BuyBotPro, Tactical Arbitrage, or repricing tools

- Experience building SOPs or product research spreadsheets



WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

- Understands Amazon resale, not private label

- Can find realistic opportunities, not just random product leads

- Is careful with compliance, account health, and supplier quality

- Takes responsibility for their work and reports clearly

- Wants to grow with a long-term e-commerce team



APPLICATION PROCESS

- Submit your resume/CV and a short cover letter detailing your Amazon Wholesale, Online Arbitrage, ungating, and supplier sourcing experience.

- Please include specific examples of products, approvals, supplier outreach, or accounts you helped support. We prefer detailed examples over general tool lists.

 subject: “I want to work with you - Amazon Marketplace Specialist - [Your Name]”

WHAT YOU WON'T HAVE TO DO



- Invent a strategy from nothing — we have one

- Shoot footage — we send you raw video and photos after every event

- Run paid ads — we handle that (though ad creative help is a plus)



REQUIREMENTS



- 1+ year of experience managing social media for a business (portfolio required — send links to accounts or content you've personally created)

- Strong CapCut (or Premiere/similar) video editing skills for Reels/TikTok

- Strong Canva skills

- Experience with event venues, weddings, hospitality, or luxury brands

- Experience working with US-based businesses



SCHEDULE



Flexible, but at least 3-4 hours of overlap with US Pacific Time (PST) for communication. Paid via Wise, on time, every time.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the word GOLD so we know you read this entire post

2. Send links to 2-3 social media accounts or pieces of content you personally created (Reels especially)

3. Tell us in 2-3 sentences why you'd be a great fit for a luxury event venue brand

Shortlisted candidates will be given a small PAID trial project: we'll send you raw footage from a real event and ask you to create 3 posts (1 Reel, 1 carousel, 1 story) using our brand guide. This is how we hire — your work speaks louder than your resume.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Ikigai Cases is hiring a Controller!

Location: Remote / Work From Home

Reports to: CEO





About the Company

Ikigai Cases (
) is a fast-growing ecommerce brand manufacturing aerospace-grade aluminum pill cases. Founded in December 2021 by two brothers after their father’s neurological diagnosis led them to discovering the issues with plastic pill organizers, we’ve built a multi-million dollar business in just over four years with a team of 25 across the globe.



Our mission is simple: make exceptional pill cases and provide exceptional customer service. We deliver on this by managing in-house fulfillment at our Washington, DC facility (including custom engraving) and maintaining obsessive attention to detail.





About the Role

We are hiring a Controller to take complete ownership of our financial operations - accounting, reporting, payroll, budgeting, cash flow, tax coordination, and financial systems. This is a critical senior role, and we’re looking for someone whose professional identity is built around three things: the integrity of the numbers, running the finance function end-to-end, and providing strategic financial insight to the CEO.



The ideal candidate has served as a Controller (or equivalent) for an e-commerce or DTC brand in the $10–30M revenue range. You understand the financial rhythms of e-commerce: Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow swings, sales tax across multiple states, and the speed at which decisions need to be made. If you’ve done this before at a similar-sized company, you already know what we need.



At $11.5M in revenue and targeting $30M by 2028, our financial complexity is outpacing our financial infrastructure. We need someone who builds systems, not just operates inside them. You’ll report directly to the CEO and work hand-in-hand with our external financial advisor. No layers of management between you and the decisions your work supports.









Core Responsibilities

Monthly Close & Financial Reporting: Close books by the 10th of every month. Produce reviewed P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements in Finaloop. Resolve misclassifications proactively. Maintain a clean chart of accounts. No CEO intervention required.



Budgeting & Financial Planning: Prepare and maintain monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets. Own budget vs. actuals: produce variance reports monthly alongside the P&L close with plain-language explanations. Update balance sheet items and expenses weekly inside the company’s financial models.



Cash Flow Management & Forecasting: Maintain the 13-week cash flow forecast weekly and proactively. Flag upcoming cash movements, exposure, and risks before they become surprises. This is one of the most critical tools the CEO uses for capital allocation.



Payroll Operations (Zero-Error Standard): Own bi-weekly payroll across ADP (US) and Deel (Philippines). Submit the morning of payroll day, every cycle. PTO, overtime, and deductions captured before submission. You catch discrepancies before they reach the CEO.



Tax Coordination & Compliance: Own the relationship with Numeral on multi-state sales tax filings. Maintain the estimated tax payment tracker. Coordinate with our external CPA on annual filings. Flag tax exposure and timing proactively.

Vendor Payments, Disbursements & Financial Systems: Execute and double-check all vendor payments (Venmo, PayPal, wire). Track owner distributions and related-party transactions. Manage Finaloop, Shopify revenue reconciliation, and Google Sheets financial modeling. Manage financial admin including insurance, vendor accounts, and benefits.



CEO Reporting & Ad Hoc Analysis: Weekly: 13WCF update, flagged variances, upcoming cash movements. Monthly: clean financial statements with brief narrative. As needed: ad hoc financial analysis without requiring a detailed spec.



Why You Should Take This Role

-You’ll work at a brand obsessed with its customers, with a loyal following. Read the reviews: 
/pages/reviews

-A company that’s scaled rapidly in 4 years and is aggressively investing in growth.

-You’ll work hand-in-hand with the founder, not through layers of management, with full autonomy to own your domain.

-The company was founded to solve a personal problem - Tavish’s father battled a neurological condition for a decade and the family discovered the issues with plastic pill organizers.

-You’ll own the entire financial function for a company on a trajectory from $11.5M to $30M - a career-defining role for the right person.





Required Experience & Skills

-5+ years in accounting, bookkeeping, or finance operations

-Prior Controller or senior finance role at a company doing $10M+ in annual revenue - you’ve owned the full financial function, not just pieces of it

-E-commerce or DTC company experience strongly preferred - Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow, multi-state sales tax

-Experience closing books independently, on a monthly cadence, without supervision

-Demonstrated accuracy record - you should be able to speak to this specifically

-US GAAP familiarity (CPA not required, but you must understand the principles)

-Experience preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets

-Payroll experience across multiple platforms

-Advanced Google Sheets / Excel (SUMIFS, financial modeling, pivot tables)

-Strong proficiency with Finaloop, QuickBooks Online, or equivalent cloud accounting platform

-Strong written and verbal English; ability to explain financial insights to non-financial stakeholders





Nice-to-Have Experience

-Experience working remotely for a US-based company from the Philippines

-Exposure to sales tax compliance across multiple US states

-Experience using Notion (or similar task management software)

-EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) familiarity

-Prior experience coordinating with external CPAs and tax advisors





What We’re Really Looking For

-Technical skills get you in the door. These traits determine whether you succeed:

-Detail orientation as professional pride - you catch your own errors before they go out, and you change your process so they don’t recur.

-Proactive disclosure - you surface problems before being asked, even when it’s uncomfortable.

-Ownership without supervision - if it’s due, it’s done. No prompting required.

-Direct communication - you push back when something doesn’t look right.

-Reliability - when you say you’ll be available, you’re available. When you can’t be, you say so immediately.





Compensation Details & Schedule

Set 12+ qualified appointments in a month and you unlock a percentage of every deal that closes the following month — regardless of when you originally set those leads.



Hit 12 = 10%

Hit 16 = 15%

Hit 20 = 20%



The more consistent you are, the more it compounds. At Bronze level, that’s an extra ~$375/month. At Gold level, that’s an extra ~$1,250/month — all on top of your base and per-appointment pay.



Working hours



9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET)

That is 10:00 PM – 6:30 AM Philippine Time (PHT).



This is a night shift role. We are fully transparent about that. There is a strong and experienced community of Filipino professionals who work US hours — if that’s you, and you’re comfortable with it, the compensation reflects the commitment.



Onboarding



Your first 10 days are structured onboarding. We walk you through everything — the script, the CRM, and the process — until you feel fully confident.



To join the core team, the target during onboarding is a minimum of 3 qualified appointments. This is a realistic and achievable bar, and we’ll be coaching you throughout to help you get there.

title: Meta Reporting Specialist / Reporting Partner Needed for a Growing Paid Media Agency
description:
We’re not just looking for someone to build reports. We’re looking for someone who understands why reporting matters. Right now, we manage 150+ active client accounts, and that number is growing. Fast. As we scale, reporting isn’t a back-office task, it’s one of the core systems that determines whether we make better decisions, earn trust, and keep 
ntum.



Our clients don’t just want numbers. They want clarity. They want consistency. They want to know what’s working and what’s not, without friction. Internally, our team depends on reporting to move quickly and make smarter calls. Clean inputs lead to better outputs. This is an opportunity to step into a long-term, recurring role where your work directly impacts how a growing agency operates.



We are not looking for someone who exports dashboards and disappears. We are looking for a partner, someone who helps protect accuracy, maintain clean connections, identify issues before they surface, and support a reporting system that can grow with us. If you are detail-oriented, organized, responsive, and already understand agency reporting, this can evolve into a consistent, expanding partnership over time.



Why This Opportunity Is Different

Most reporting roles are about repetition. Build the report. Send the report. Repeat. This role is about responsibility. You will help support the reporting infrastructure behind a paid media agency that is actively growing and constantly evolving. 

That means working closely with media buyers, account managers, and tracking teams to ensure every report reflects reality, accurately, completely, and clearly. Because we manage a high volume of accounts, things change. Accounts go inactive. New ones launch. Some need restructuring. Others need updates. The details matter here, and your ability to catch them is part of the value you bring. The right partner won’t feel like an external vendor. They’ll feel like part of the system. 

As we grow, there will be opportunities to go beyond execution, improving dashboards, refining reporting processes, shaping client-facing templates, and contributing to how reporting evolves across the business.



Position Details

Position: Reporting Specialist / Reporting Contractor / Reporting Agency Partner

Location: Remote

Role Type: Outsourced contractor or agency partnership

Primary Reporting Tool: Reports Garden (but not limited to)

Budget: Approximately $25 per client per month

Report Frequency: 2 reports per client per month

Workload: Based on the number of active clients assigned



Partnership Structure

You will work alongside our internal team to produce reports that meet our standards, consistently and reliably. This means coordinating with media buyers, account managers, and the pixels/tracking team to ensure the data being reported is accurate, complete, and properly connected. We prefer partners who already have a system, your own process, infrastructure, and the ability to scale as volume increases. This is not a role for constant oversight. It’s a role for ownership. We will provide standards, expectations, and guidelines. You bring execution, precision, and experience.



Core Skills and Requirements

You should have:

Experience creating marketing, advertising, or performance reports for agencies or client accounts

Familiarity with paid media reporting, especially Meta Ads

Experience using reporting platforms such as Reports Garden, Looker Studio, AgencyAnalytics, Whatagraph, or similar tools

Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify inconsistencies in data

Understanding of account connections, data sources, tracking alignment, and reporting accuracy

Ability to collaborate with media buying, operations, account management, and tracking teams

Strong communication skills and responsiveness

Ability to follow established reporting standards

Comfort managing recurring deadlines

Ability to work independently while escalating issues when necessary

Existing internal processes, team, or infrastructure (if applying as an agency)

Ability to scale as the number of clients increases



Responsibilities

As our Reporting Specialist or Reporting Partner, you will be responsible for:

Producing 2 reports per client per month

Creating reports that align with our internal reporting standards

Managing and maintaining account connections within Reports Garden

Verifying data accuracy before reports are delivered

Identifying missing, broken, outdated, or inconsistent data sources

Ensuring reports are connected to the correct active accounts

Flagging inactive, disconnected, or incorrect accounts before finalization

Coordinating with the pixels/tracking team to resolve data issues

Working with media buyers and account managers to gather necessary inputs and context

Delivering reports on schedule

Maintaining consistency across all assigned client reports

Identifying and escalating issues early, before deadlines become problems

Contributing to improvements in the reporting process as volume grows



What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a long-term partner, someone who wants to help build something that works, not just complete tasks. This is a strong fit for a specialist or small team that understands agency reporting and is looking for consistent, recurring work tied to real growth. You shouldn’t need constant direction once the system is clear. You should be able to follow standards, manage your time, communicate clearly, and take ownership of accuracy. Because reporting isn’t just reporting. It’s how trust is built, with clients and within the team. These reports shape decisions. They influence strategy. They determine what happens next. Accuracy, consistency, and accountability are not optional, they’re the work.



Budget and Scope



Our working budget is approximately $25 per client per month.

Each client requires 2 reports per month.



Sample Compensation = 160 clients x $25 = $4,000/month



Please apply only if this structure aligns with your workflow, team, and capacity. We are open to working with individual contractors, specialized reporting freelancers, or small agencies.



To Apply: Send a sample comprehensive meta report that you've created via google drive link. 



Preference will be given to partners who can handle recurring reporting needs and grow alongside us as volume increases.
